title: Full-Stack ML Engineer - Data Products (m/f/d)
description:
At
 **Statista** 
 , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy\-to\-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact\-based decisions.
   

  

 Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.
   

  

 We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.
   

  

 Are you ready to join us?
   

  

**Your role**
 As a Full\-Stack ML Engineer, you will be at the heart of turning raw data into elegant, reliable products. You'll work across the entire stack: strong focus on building robust backend services, building data pipelines, leveraging ML, and working on customer facing UIs. You'll own your work end to end. This is a role for someone who thinks beyond tickets, cares deeply about quality, and gets excited about the intersection of data and product.
   

  

* Write well\-structured, maintainable code in Python and Typescript that your teammates will actually enjoy working with
* Transform data into meaningful, impactful products our customers rely on every day
* Apply ML and LLM to understand the data and leverage it to build services
* Build and evolve both customer\-facing and internal services and UIs
* Own the full software lifecycle: from design and development through code reviews, deployment, and long\-term maintainability
* Communicate fluently in English (written and spoken) — German is a welcome bonus


**Your profile**
* 5\+ years of professional experience building front\- and back\-end services, with the main focus on back\-end
* Leveraging ML and LLMs to build intelligent data products
* AWS cloud infrastructure and CDK
* Proven ability to ship production\-ready Python and Typescript back\-ends
* A creative problem\-solving mindset — you don't just fix bugs, you ask why they exist
* Genuine curiosity and openness to learning new technologies
* A true team player with a strong sense of personal ownership


**Bonus Points**
 You'll stand out if you bring knowledge in any of the following:
   

  

* build and used MCP services
* REST API design
* proficiency in HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks — especially React


**What We Offer**
 In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:
   

  

* Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year
* Hybrid work and flex\-time
* International team and social events
* Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options
* Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities
* Career \& training opportunities
* Attractive locations and modern offices
* Mental health support with OpenUp


*Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior\-level roles or above.*
